PR: allow customizing signature algorithm [closed; labels size/L, release-note, approved, lgtm, area/api, kind/feature, dco-signoff: yes, ok-to-test, area/deploy]
### Pull Request Motivation

Cert-manager currently has a hard-coded mapping from private key algorithm and size to the signature algorithm used. Some services have requirement and limitations on the accepted hash algorithm, e.g. `SHA512WithRSA` might be not supported although 3072-bit RSA keys are accepted. Give the user the freedom to choose a signature algorithm regardless of key size.

Example:
```yaml
apiVersion: cert-manager.io…

signatureAlgorithm: SHA256WithRSA
```

This is an opt-in API. If `signatureAlgorithm` is omitted the existing default mapping takes over.

### Kind

/kind feature

### Release Note

```release-note
allow customizing signature algorithm
```
